title: RPG Maker 2k/3 RTP Battler Sprite Edits

posts.author: Orka
posts.body:
Welcome!
This is a collection of Battler sprites that I have edited over the years. Some of the old ones are a little bit low quality edits, since I threw them together in Paint, they are in the spoiler below. The rest of them have been made with more proper tools that I keep using, so as I go I keep improving my editing skills. I will update the thread whenever I get any new ideas.
(
Also a little disclaimer: There are some RM2k3 edits that have RM2k assets, those edits will be put in a separate section. All credits go to Degica and Kadokawa. No need to credit me. I think it goes without saying, you have to own either RPG Maker 2000 or RPG Maker 2003 or both to use these edits according to how the edits are labelled.
)
